result.summary: Found 1 minor content issue with missing spacing in promotional text.

issues.description: In the green promotional banner, the text 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' has a missing space between 'checkout' and '·', resulting in 'checkout· min.' instead of the intended 'checkout · min.'
issues.suggestion: Add a space between 'checkout' and '·' to ensure proper spacing and readability of the promotional message.
